capabilities: Loads ICS feeds and CalDAV calendars
Colors events by category or per event
Shows Tasks due dates on the calendar
extras: Tasks integration is experimental and needs a forked Tasks plugin; habit pie charts need a compatible habit tracker. Migration from the original Full Calendar copies data.json; event notes are unchanged.
intentEvidence: This is a fork of Full Calendar by Davis Haupt.
motivation: The author uses Full Calendar every day, so they maintain the fork and add the features they were missing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar, and the original Full Calendar plugin is no longer developed.

relations.evidence: This is a fork of Full Calendar by Davis Haupt.
Show the due dates of your Tasks on the calendar.

requires.name: Tasks (forked version with the unofficial API)

summary: Maintained fork of Full Calendar that keeps events as vault notes, with categories, ICS and CalDAV calendars, live previews and keyboard shortcuts.
